b6_reason: The ADA-corrected lymphocytes are mortal and die out, so the infusion must be repeated periodically; a permanent cure needs the gene in marrow stem cells at an early stage.
b6_note: Option 3 text is garbled by character transposition ('ntLymphocytes from patie 's blood'), and option 2 has a broken word ('stag es'), but option 4 is intact and is the causal reason asked for.
